summary: No wild fruit trees grow on this map, so the 100 Fruit must come from planted Apple and Fig Trees tended by Orchards. Get Planks, plant a large orchard early, and feed the town with the existing Farm, Windmill and Bakery so the Fruit is stockpiled rather than eaten. Edgar makes villagers eat less.

build_order.note: About 15 to bear early: 7 days to mature, then one fruit every 3 to 3.7 days.
About 30: 10 days to mature, then one fruit every 1.65 to 2.5 days, so they out-produce Figs.
Second Orchard once more than about 25 trees are planted.
Clay for later buildings; staff the Farm, Windmill and Bakery so Bread feeds the town.
4 Planks. Optional: 60 of the Fruit stored in Markets; build it late.

pitfalls: Each tree holds at most 3 or 4 uncollected fruit and stops; Orchard workers must keep picking.
Fruit is food: if Bread runs short the stockpile shrinks.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
